description: Performance sweep - Python: valkey-glide-python vs redis-py (high-throughput configs). There is no bench-aws.sh version flag for this client: bump valkey-glide in python/pyproject.toml on a pushed ref and pass --repo-tag. redis-py is the stable yardstick, so compare GLIDE/redis-py ratios across runs to cancel instance-to-instance noise. Connections and iterations match perf-ruby.
